url.description: The page address, as the sitemap gives it.

lastmod.description: Last modification: a date (2026-01-31) when the sitemap gives no time, otherwise ISO 8601 UTC. Null when absent or unreadable.

changefreq.description: The sitemap's change frequency hint, e.g. daily.

sitemapUrl.description: The sitemap file the URL was read from.

site.description: The input entry the URL belongs to.

images.description: With includeExtensions: the entry's images (url, title, caption).

videos.description: With includeExtensions: the entry's videos (title, description, thumbnailUrl, contentUrl, playerUrl, durationSeconds, publicationDate).

news.description: With includeExtensions: the entry's news data (title, publicationName, language, publicationDate).

alternates.description: With includeExtensions: the entry's language versions (hreflang, href).
